formats.key: redemptionPaymentDefault((bytes32[] merkleProof, (bytes32 attestationType, bytes32 sourceId, uint64 votingRound, uint64 lowestUsedTimestamp, (uint64 minimalBlockNumber, uint64 deadlineBlockNumber, uint64 deadlineTimestamp, bytes32 destinationAddressHash, uint256 amount, bytes32 standardPaymentReference, bool checkSourceAddresses, bytes32 sourceAddressesRoot) responseBody) data) _proof, uint256 _redemptionRequestId)
effects: When the signer is the redeemer: the signer receives the agent's vault collateral, and pool collateral if needed, worth the redeemed value times a default factor. The amount comes from prices and settings in storage.
When the signer is the appointed executor: the signer receives the stored executor fee as WNat.
When the signer is the agent owner: the agent vault's collateral is paid to the redeemer and the executor fee is burned.

formats.key: executeDirectMinting((bytes32[] merkleProof, (bytes32 attestationType, bytes32 sourceId, uint64 votingRound, uint64 lowestUsedTimestamp, (bytes32 transactionId, address proofOwner) requestBody, (uint64 blockNumber, uint64 blockTimestamp, string sourceAddress, bytes32 sourceAddressHash, bytes32 receivingAddressHash, bytes32 intendedReceivingAddressHash, int256 spentAmount, int256 intendedSpentAmount, int256 receivedAmount, int256 intendedReceivedAmount, bool hasMemoData, bytes firstMemoData, bool hasDestinationTag, uint256 destinationTag, uint8 status) responseBody) data) _payment)
effects: Sends msg.value FLR. It is refunded if the minting is delayed, forwarded to the smart account manager on the smart-account path, and must be zero on the direct-recipient path.
On the direct-recipient path, mints the executor fee (executorFeeAmg from storage) in FXRP to the signer.
Mints the received XRP amount minus the minting fee and executor fee as FXRP to a recipient. The recipient comes from the tag registry or the memo, or it is the smart account manager.
Mints the minting fee in FXRP to the fee receiver.

findings.title: executeDirectMinting does not show the FXRP executor fee the signer receives; the rate is in storage.

formats.key: executeDirectMintingWithData((bytes32[] merkleProof, (bytes32 attestationType, bytes32 sourceId, uint64 votingRound, uint64 lowestUsedTimestamp, (bytes32 transactionId, address proofOwner) requestBody, (uint64 blockNumber, uint64 blockTimestamp, string sourceAddress, bytes32 sourceAddressHash, bytes32 receivingAddressHash, bytes32 intendedReceivingAddressHash, int256 spentAmount, int256 intendedSpentAmount, int256 receivedAmount, int256 intendedReceivedAmount, bool hasMemoData, bytes firstMemoData, bool hasDestinationTag, uint256 destinationTag, uint8 status) responseBody) data) _payment, bytes _data)
effects: Sends msg.value FLR. On the smart-account path it goes with _data to the smart account manager, which must pay the executor. It is refunded if the minting is delayed.
Mints the received XRP minus the minting fee as FXRP to the smart account manager, then calls handleMintedFAssets with _data and the signer as executor.
On the direct-recipient path, reverts because data is not allowed there (NoDataExpectedForDirectMinting).
Mints the minting fee in FXRP to the fee receiver.
